cards.meaning: Specific to joint 10 in the declared serial order. Squared half-span home displacement multiplied by squared limit pressure.
cards.possibleUse: Candidate input for testing whether joint 10 research home-displacement and limit-pressure interaction helps held-out solver-outcome discrimination; incremental usefulness must be measured by paired ablation.
cards.limitations: Product represents co-occurrence for this joint; it is not causal interaction evidence. If jointCount<10, all7 research slots for this joint are exactly0; interpret using joint_10_present. No features depend on solved coordinates. Margins and pressure derive from the same validated seed and limits. Only finite, dimensionally matched inputs with positive joint spans, valid joint types, seed/home inside limits and zero active DH fields are admitted. Encoder values are Float; overflow after conversion rejects the row. Classifier training normalization is a separate train-fitted operation, clipped to [-8,8], not this feature formula.
